title: PromptHound LLM audit event
description: One JSON object per LLM or agent operation. Fields annotated x-origin=otel use OpenTelemetry GenAI semantic-convention attribute names; x-origin=prompthound fields are extensions. x-class is metadata (recorded without analyzing content), derived (produced by a content detector), or content (raw prompt, response or tool payload).

timestamp.description: Operation time as an RFC 3339 timestamp with a UTC offset.

event.id.description: Unique event identifier; used to deduplicate replayed events.

event.outcome.description: Operation outcome. blocked means a policy stopped the operation.

gen_ai.operation.name.description: Operation name. Well-known values include chat, generate_content, text_completion, embeddings, retrieval, execute_tool, invoke_agent, create_agent and invoke_workflow.

gen_ai.conversation.id.description: Conversation or session identifier, unique within the tenant.

gen_ai.provider.name.description: Model provider, for example openai, anthropic or aws.bedrock.

service.name.description: Name of the LLM application or gateway.

deployment.environment.name.description: Deployment environment, for example production or staging.

user.id.description: Pseudonymous principal identifier, unique within the tenant.

user.roles.description: Roles or authorization groups of the principal.

user.tenant.id.description: Tenant or organization identifier. Every correlation groups by it.

api_key.id.description: Opaque or hashed API key identifier. Never the key itself.

client.address.description: Address of the client that called the gateway.

http.request.id.description: Request identifier for correlation with upstream HTTP logs.

gen_ai.usage.reasoning.output_tokens.description: Reasoning tokens, when the provider reports them.

gen_ai.response.finish_reasons.description: Finish reason per choice, for example stop, length, tool_calls or content_filter.

cost.usd.description: Gateway-computed cost of the operation in US dollars.

error.type.description: Low-cardinality error class when the operation failed.

guardrail.input.flagged.description: An input guardrail flagged the request.

guardrail.input.categories.description: Input guardrail categories, for example injection or pii.

guardrail.output.flagged.description: An output guardrail flagged the response.

policy.decision.description: Gateway policy decision for the operation.

gen_ai.data_source.id.description: Identifier of the data source used for retrieval.

rag.retrieved.count.description: Number of retrieved chunks added to the model context.

rag.source.types.description: Types of the retrieved sources, for example web, email, file, ticket or db.

gen_ai.tool.type.description: Tool type, for example function, extension or datastore.

tool.call.depth.description: Position of this call in the current tool chain.

tool.call.chain.description: Names of the tools invoked so far in this turn, in order.

tool.call.outcome.description: Outcome of the tool call. denied means an authorization policy refused it.

output.sink.description: Downstream consumer that received the model output.

output.rendered_unsanitized.description: The output reached its sink without sanitization or escaping.

gen_ai.system_instructions.description: System instructions supplied to the model.

gen_ai.input.messages.description: Input messages in the OpenTelemetry message format: {role, parts}.

gen_ai.output.messages.description: Output messages in the OpenTelemetry message format: {role, parts, finish_reason}.

content.input.injection_markers.description: Number of prompt-injection or instruction-extraction markers a detector found in the input.

content.output.contains_system_prompt.description: A detector found system-instruction content in the output.

content.output.pii.types.description: Personal-data classes a detector found in the output, for example email, phone or ssn.

content.output.secret.types.description: Credential classes a detector found in the output, for example api_key or private_key.
